usable_improvement: One original editable unitless Ari trouser technical SVG with front/profile/rear and inside/detail views, source-role JSON and artist handoff. Qualify its first whole rendered image; no raster tracing, variants or 3D.
bounded_question: Which single authored waist/closure/pocket/seat/leg/hem contract makes the original ink trouser silhouette useful to an artist while keeping ambiguous pleats/waist and anatomical/physical fit unclaimed?
decision: Select one explicit flat-front fly/waist construction or one explicit elastic-waist alternative from actual image and one primary garment example if useful; draw original proposals only after independent worth/source review. Refuse unsupported attribution of authored details to the concept.
phase_zero: Independent critic assesses worth from pinned artist handoffs and actual whole original Ari image. Root independently views whole image after worth. At most one current official garment reference with a real design/image example if it changes construction choice; preserve source/pixel limits.
phase_one: One original vector drawing, complete element/role association JSON and local review page. Make panel sides/seam/closure/pocket-bag/hem duties literal and legible; explicit authored inside proposal, unitless art not sewing pattern. Critic source preflight before root first browser/software rendering.
phase_two: One actual whole rendered image at fixed declared viewport, root serialized. Critic independently inspects actual image/source and two alternatives per actionable issue. No retake/tuning iteration; retain limitations and choose next direction if first art fails.

alternatives.description: Original flat-front broad leg with explicit fly, shaped waistband and pocket-bag proposals.
alternatives.tradeoff: Clarifies conventional closure and lower silhouette; waist/pleat/seat shaping is newly authored and needs later pattern/fit work.

alternatives.description: Original elastic waistband/pull-on broad leg with explicit casing and pocket roles.
alternatives.tradeoff: Offers adjustable waist intent with fewer fly layers; gathered top and drape may alter the quiet original silhouette and still need physical material/fit qualification.
